name: Overdue invoices growing
query: Percentage change in sacco_invoices_outstanding{status="overdue"} comparing the current gauge value to its value 24 hours ago.
notes: Mirrors the Billing dashboard's overdue invoices trend panel (infra/observability/logfire/dashboards/billing.json). A growing overdue count can indicate a payment-processing issue, the subscription-gate/dunning flow stalling, or a wave of tenant non-payment worth escalating to finance.
